What you're describing is not ice tilt. Ice tilt is generally understood as competitive balance. Where you have a great top-tier team, every player being a high rating and you're loaded with synergies. Then you play against someone with a poor team, no one over a certain rating, no synergies whatsoever, and that team outperforms you in EVERY aspect of the game and wins. Like when your top player gets caught by a lesser player, or you get out-skated by a slower player, they stick/poke check better than your guys, and the list goes on and on, etc.

You're talking about your opponent just being selective with their shots. They probably scored on one-timers, cross-crease, or slot shots. Just because you shoot a lot or have a lot of time on attack doesn't mean much overall.
